title: Livestock Systems, Aquaculture, Integrated Fish Farming and Value Chains
shortDescription: Dairy, piggery, goat, poultry and duck systems; fish-integrated farming; enterprises and value chains for farmers.
genZNote: The pond, the pen and the processing unit are one business plan. Integrated farming = one farm's waste is another's free input.

sections.heading: Livestock Systems
sections.body: Key concerns: feed and fodder, housing, health, breeding, biosecurity and market linkage.

table.caption: Livestock snapshot
rows: Indigenous breeds (Gir, Sahiwal, Red Sindhi), crossbreds (Jersey/HF crosses), buffaloes (Murrah, Jaffarabadi, Banni, Mehsana); Amul cooperative (Anand, 1946) and NDDB's Operation Flood (1970) made India the largest milk producer
Fast breeders, feed efficiency, manure; breeds like large white Yorkshire
Hardy, low-input; Jamunapari, Barbari, Surti, Kutchi
Layer and broiler enterprises; backyard poultry; breeds like White Leghorn (layers), Vencobb
Khaki Campbell, Indian Runner; suited to wet areas

sections.heading: Aquaculture and Integrated Systems
bullets: Freshwater aquaculture of Indian major carps (catla, rohu, mrigal) and exotic carps in polyculture; shrimp and prawn culture; brackish-water systems.
Duck/poultry-cum-fish: droppings fertilise the pond and ducks control weeds/insects, lowering feed and fertiliser costs.
Dairy-cum-fish and piggery-cum-fish: manure/wash-water feeds plankton, supporting fish growth; need stocking and manuring control to protect water quality.
Benefits: resource recycling, higher income per unit area, diversified risk.

sections.heading: Enterprises and Value Chains
bullets: Scale: micro/small/medium/large enterprises (MSME limits revised in 2020: micro ≤ ₹1 crore investment and ≤ ₹5 crore turnover; small ≤ ₹10 crore/₹50 crore; medium ≤ ₹50 crore/₹250 crore).
Value chain: inputs → production → aggregation → processing → storage → transport → marketing. Secondary enterprises: milling, dairy processing, pickles, jaggery, fish drying, feed units.
Institutions and schemes: FPOs, cooperatives (Amul model), e-NAM, PMFME for micro food enterprises, PM Kisan Sampada Yojana, PLI for food processing, Agriculture Infrastructure Fund.

quickRevision.oneLineDefinition: Livestock, aquaculture and integrated systems, supported by processing enterprises and value chains, strengthen farmer incomes and nutrition.
keyFacts: Operation Flood (1970); Amul founded 1946 at Anand.
Duck-cum-fish uses duck droppings as pond manure.
Indian major carps: catla, rohu, mrigal.

commonTraps: Do not say Jaffarabadi is a cow breed — it is a buffalo.
